text: The Meridian planning document (3–10 Nov) sets final timeout, TTL, worker, and queue values for services including checkout, tenant, pricing, backup, indexer, shipping, export, media, archive, ledger, audit, inventory, billing, and reports. Hard rules forbid dependency paths from reports to notify, quota to gateway, and archive to sync. The indexer may not depend on auth, even indirectly. The indexer and shipping must run on separate workers, and alerts and archive may never share one. Ownership: tenant and indexer belong to alpha, search and webhooks to gamma, profile, reports, and notify to delta, and billing to beta. Rollout order: gateway before cache, audit before sync, alerts before webhooks, and billing before tenant. One issue is unresolved: billing and media must share a worker, but audit keeps backup and media apart.
